title: "Waiting for feedback, approval, access, equipment or data"
status: "broad-beta pathway"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

## Diagnose

Is work waiting on a named external action, or is the current route unable to produce the required outcome? Record submitted, received, under review, approved and rejected as different states.

## Do now

1. Name the required decision and its owner.
2. Record request, receipt, agreed response and latest feasible decision dates.
3. Identify work that can proceed safely.
4. Prepare a realistic fallback.
5. Follow up at the agreed threshold.
6. Escalate before the protected buffer is exhausted.

## Before asking

Bring the dated record, milestone impact, safe interim work, alternatives and one requested decision.

## Stop or escalate

No response is not permission. Do not begin affected work before required approval or use informal access, credentials or storage.

## Evidence of unstuck

The authorised decision exists or a documented alternative/formal schedule change is active. Another follow-up message alone is not resolution.

Use the [risk register](../templates/risk-issues-register.qmd) and [escalation builder](../templates/escalation-message.qmd).
